summary: The oldest of Mount Rainier's four surviving fire lookouts, built 1932, restored, and still used in high fire danger.

facts.design: two-story NPS standard design, 14x14 ft cab with catwalk, ground-floor storage room

staffing.status: staffed into the 1980s, no longer regularly staffed

access.note: within Mount Rainier National Park, reached by trail; not a rental

visit.trail_note: trail access within the park; NPS structure, not open for public entry

events.note: built to a standard NPS Branch of Plans and Designs plan
added to National Register of Historic Places, March 13, 1991
registered on National Historic Lookout Register, December 15, 1996
staffed into the 1980s per Fire Lookout Museum account
restored following original plans; still used in critical fire weather per NHLR

evidence.supports: built 1932, two-story 14x14 cab with catwalk, standard 1930s NPS design, restored, still used in critical fire weather, oldest of four remaining lookouts, NHLR registered Dec 15 1996
evidence.quote: The two-story wooden frame structure with 14'x 14' cab and catwalk is representative of a standard National Park Service design of the 1930s. The oldest of four lookouts remaining in the Park, it has been restored following the original plans. It is still used in critical fire weather.

evidence.supports: built 1932, ground-floor storage, upper lookout/living space, NRHP listed March 13 1991, part of Mount Rainier National Historic Landmark District
evidence.quote: Built in 1932 to a standard design by the National Park Service Branch of Plans and Designs, the wood-frame lookout features a ground-floor storage room and an upper-level lookout and living space with windows on all four sides.

evidence.supports: staffed into the 1980s, built 1932, two-story frame cab, listed on NHLR
evidence.quote: This 2-story frame cab, built in 1932, was staffed into the 1980's. It is listed on the National Historic Lookout Register.

evidence.supports: current status standing, NHLR registration number
evidence.quote: Shriner Peak Pierce 46.81362 -121.53054 2-Story cab Standing NHLR US 207, WA 26

notes_for_editor: No source gave an exact trail name/mileage within budget; left access as general trail note rather than inventing specifics. No distinct fire events found tied to this lookout specifically.
